Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
poc=Path('/workspace/poc3.txt')
poc.write_text('ip and (tcp port 80 or udp port 53) and not vlan\n')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/testprogs/fuzz/fuzz_filter.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":12,"var":"Data/Size","code":"if (Size < 1) return 0;","note":"The fuzzer entry point accepts attacker-controlled bytes as long as one byte is present."},
{"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/testprogs/fuzz/fuzz_filter.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":18,"var":"pkts","code":"pkts = pcap_open_dead(Data[Size-1], 0xFFFF);","note":"The final byte becomes the linktype for the dead pcap handle and affects compilation context."},
{"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/testprogs/fuzz/fuzz_filter.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":23,"var":"filter","code":"filter = malloc(Size); memcpy(filter, Data, Size); filter[Size-1] = 0;","note":"The rest of the bytes become a NUL-terminated filter string completely controlled by the attacker."},
{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/gencode.c","function":"pcap_compile","line":760,"var":"scanner input","code":"in_buffer = pcap__scan_string(xbuf ? xbuf : \"\", scanner);","note":"The filter text is parsed into the compiler's intermediate representation."},
{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/gencode.c","function":"pcap_compile","line":798,"var":"cstate.ic","code":"if (bpf_optimize(&cstate.ic, p->errbuf) == -1) { ... }","note":"The optimizer is invoked on the attacker-shaped IR; this is the stage associated with the reported crash state."},
{"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"fold_op","line":740,"var":"opt_state","code":"if (b == 0) opt_error(opt_state, \"division by zero\");","note":"The optimizer can detect illegal constant expressions and abort through opt_error, which stresses the cleanup path."},
{"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"bpf_optimize","line":1904,"var":"opt_state.top_ctx","code":"if (setjmp(opt_state.top_ctx)) { opt_cleanup(&opt_state); return -1; }","note":"Any opt_error longjmps into this handler, which immediately tears down optimizer allocations."},
{"step":8,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"opt_cleanup","line":2030,"var":"opt_state->blocks","code":"free((void *)opt_state->blocks);","note":"The cleanup routine frees the graph memory; the vulnerability hypothesis is that the same allocation can be freed twice when the optimizer's error and normal exit paths both execute."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2)+'\n')
print('ready')
PY
